verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a hosted email service with web and mobile clients, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a setting or policy for opting out of telemetry or usage tracking. A community remark that Fastmail is 'up front with how the data is handled' describes transparency, not an opt-out control, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
